evidence.quote:
Ricursive Intelligence
just released
Ripple-65B Preview
. Ripple-65B Preview is a 65B dense open-weight model from Ricursive, pretrained from scratch for agentic coding. It is a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model behind Ricursive’s AI chip design platform. The main claim:
80.52 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
, the top self-reported score among US open-weight models. Every MoE rival it beats on that test carries 501B to 975B total parameters.

The release includes
3 checkpoints
: an instruction-tuned BF16 model, an
NVFP4 version
, and a
BF16 base model
. All ship under Apache 2.0. Pretraining used a text-only corpus, mostly English and code, at 8K sequence length.

title: Ricursive AI Releases Ripple-65B Preview: A 65B Dense Open-Weight Model Scoring 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
displayTitle: Ricursive发布Ripple-65B预览版，押注代码Agent与芯片设计
summary: MarkTechPost报道Ricursive发布65B稠密开权重模型Ripple-65B Preview，提供三个检查点并采用Apache 2.0许可；Terminal-Bench 2.1分数为厂商自报。
investorNote: 芯片设计AI公司把内部模型能力外放为通用编码模型，可扩大开发者触达；自报榜单与硬件成本需要第三方复验。
narrative: Ricursive发布Ripple-65B Preview，MarkTechPost称它是面向Agent编码预训练的**65B稠密开权重模型**，提供指令版、基础版和NVFP4版本，许可为Apache 2.0。公司自报Terminal-Bench 2.1得分80.52，但不同测试设置与推理成本尚需独立比较。Ricursive原本把模型用于芯片设计平台，此次公开通用检查点，显示垂直AI公司也在把底层模型作为生态入口。

eventRelation.reason: 当日独立动作；与近两周已存事件的具体发生不同
